proposed.text: A performing arts center in Manila has a stage with a floor area of 240 m² measured within the stage walls. Per PD 1096, Rule XII, Section 1213.1, what is the minimum required total area of stage ventilators?

12.00 m² minimum projection room area per projector
15.00 m² per projector (exceeds the required minimum)

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: The 5% rule is the most frequently tested provision in Section 1213. Any stage must have metal or incombustible ventilators positioned near the center above the highest part of the working stage, with total area ≥ 5% of the stage floor. The ventilator also serves as a smoke exhaust during fire events. The stage floor measurement is taken within the stage walls, not the overall building footprint.
